title: Conditional central-context Q3 history composition
question: If every actual Q3 source difference has all four A^(a) D A^(-b) contexts at the one-step rate B, does the central insertion identity give a uniform B^n word bound and the corresponding factorial first-passage envelope?

upstream_input.rate_definition: B is recomputed from the actual onsite, three edge and six bond source polynomials at S=1/4 using the registered weighted mixed graph inputs.
upstream_input.rate_role: B is a proposed central-context bound; EXP-001045 supplies only the one-step weighted mixed source rate and does not prove all four central contexts.

central_context.hypothesis: For every source difference D in the declared Q3 common core, all four contexts are bounded by the same B, uniformly in finite volume, source location and orientation.
central_context.conditional_word_bound: Under the central-context hypothesis and a submultiplicative common-core norm, every n-factor word is bounded by B^n.

first_passage_bridge.hypothesis: A nonnegative two-orientation factorial Duhamel/first-passage expansion is supplied separately.
first_passage_bridge.conclusion: Conditionally, the distance-d envelope is spatial_base^(-distance)*exp(eta).

scope.not_closed: The central-context hypothesis, the actual factorial Q3 history recurrence, all-shape exhaustion Cauchy estimate, common alpha, KMS/OS reconstruction, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

adversarial_review.check: The four-context table is a new hypothesis; EXP-001045's one-step rate is not silently promoted to the missing A^s D A^(-s) context.
A^(-s)A^s cancellation is used only on the declared common core and does not assert unbounded-operator domain closure.
The diagonal A and scaled finite matrices test the insertion and norm bookkeeping only; they do not identify the actual Q3 source differences.
The exponential envelope assumes a nonnegative factorial first-passage expansion; no actual Duhamel recurrence is claimed.
The spatial base and distance factor remain explicit, so no unweighted moving-site uniformity or exhaustion estimate is inferred.
R230 checks a finite group insertion identity and exact rational fixtures, not Q3 operator domains or history convergence.
No thermodynamic dynamics, OS/KMS reconstruction, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion follows.
No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied by this conditional package.
